title: Forms with React Hook Form + Zod
outcome: Build robust forms with React Hook Form and Zod while separating transient form state from authoritative server state.
artifact: Create/edit task forms with shared field rules, accessible errors, async submission, server-error mapping, and reset behavior.
labSteps: Define form values and defaults before wiring UI fields.
Register basic fields and observe dirty/touched/submitting state intentionally.
Connect Zod resolver and reuse only rules that genuinely belong in both client and API validation.
Implement accessible field errors and focus behavior after invalid submit.
Send data through the mutation layer and map server validation/conflict errors back to fields or form-level feedback.
Implement edit/reset/cancel semantics and test what happens when server data changes while a form is open.
failureModes: Duplicating server data into form state without reset strategy
Assuming client validation secures the API
Clearing user input on every failed request
Showing only generic toast instead of actionable field errors
mastery: Can distinguish form state from server state
Can reason about create vs edit/reset lifecycles
principles: React Hook Form should own transient form interaction while Zod defines the input contract.
Validate close to the user for feedback, but repeat trust-boundary validation on the backend.
Map server validation errors back to fields without losing non-field errors.
Reset or preserve form state deliberately after successful mutations based on the workflow.
